title: The Best Z-Wave Door and Window Sensors
subtitle: Battery Z-Wave contact sensors, ranked from live Amazon data.
intro: We pulled the Z-Wave door and window sensors selling on Amazon and scored them on rating, review volume, and features: 800 Series Long Range radios, extra sensors, and recessed designs. The list is short because few makers still sell standalone Z-Wave contact sensors.
data_source: Amazon product listings on the data_captured date. Prices, ratings and review counts change daily; check the listing before relying on a number.

awards.label: Best Overall
awards.name: Zooz ZSE41 800LR
awards.why: A tiny 800 Series Long Range sensor that fits almost any frame, with an optional outdoor case.

awards.label: Best for Ring Alarm
awards.name: Ring Alarm Contact Sensor (2nd gen)
awards.why: Nearly 30,000 reviews at 4.7 stars, for homes running Ring Alarm.

awards.label: Most Sensors
awards.name: Aeotec Door Window Sensor 8
awards.why: Open/close plus tilt, vibration, temperature, humidity, and mold-risk alerts.

awards.label: Best Hidden
awards.name: Aeotec Recessed Door Sensor 7
awards.why: Recessed design that disappears inside the door frame.

systems_note: Ring's sensor is made for the Ring Alarm base station; Ring doesn't support other Z-Wave hubs.

buyers_guide.q: How do door and window sensors work?
buyers_guide.a: A magnet goes on the door or window and the sensor goes on the frame. When the two separate, the sensor reports open. Mount them within the gap the listing specifies, usually under an inch.

buyers_guide.q: How long do the batteries last?
buyers_guide.a: Most battery sensors on these lists are rated for one to three years, depending on how often they report. Low-power radios like Zigbee, Z-Wave, and Thread last much longer than Wi-Fi.

buyers_guide.q: Can I use these as a security system?
buyers_guide.a: They can trigger alerts and sirens through your smart home system, but they aren't a monitored alarm. For insurance discounts or police dispatch you need a professionally monitored system.
